question: How many cups of chai are consumed in India daily?
idealClarificationQuestions: Cup defined as a standard 100-150 ml serving (kulhad, paper cup, glass)? Yes — average ~120 ml.
Both home-brewed and tapri/cafe chai counted? Yes — total consumption.
Black tea + milk tea + green tea / herbal tea? Primarily milk tea (chai); exclude herbal/green which is ~5% of total tea consumption.
Pan-India average day, not festival? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: segment population into chai-drinkers vs non-drinkers, then layer cups/day by segment, average across population.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Light (1 cup/day — young, kids, occasional drinkers): ~25% = 305M @ 1 cup/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~3.5 billion cups of chai per day.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Light (1 cup/day — young, kids, occasional drinkers)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3.5 billion cups of chai per day.

calculationFlow: Tea-drinking population (excludes infants <2, exclusive coffee drinkers, tea-averse): ~85% = ~1.23 billion.
- Heavy drinkers (4+ cups/day — laborers, offices with pantry, chai-frequent households): ~30% = 370M @ 5 cups/day.
- Moderate (2-3 cups/day — most middle-class adults): ~45% = 555M @ 2.5 cups/day.
- Light (1 cup/day — young, kids, occasional drinkers): ~25% = 305M @ 1 cup/day.
Round: ~3.5 billion cups of chai per day.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~3.5 billion cups of chai per day.
